notes.text: An occasional, optional survey can now show a "Help fill a survey" pill in the sidebar, above the update pill. Click it to answer; answers are sent anonymously with a random ID, the app version and your operating system. Each survey shows once, and the pill's X dismisses it
Settings > Appearance now has a Font dropdown to switch the interface font between Inter and the new Allo. Allo covers Latin and Vietnamese; other scripts fall back to Inter
Linux: with "Close application on project open" on, the GodotHub window no longer comes back as an empty transparent window after the project's editor closes or the tray icon is clicked
